source.note: Footnotes are kept here, apart from the verse text, as eBible.org wrote them. Built by tools/build-web-updated.py.

notes.after: e Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor
notes.text: Greek παρακλητον: Counselor, Helper, Intercessor, Advocate, and Comforter.

notes.after: And he is the atoning sacrifice
notes.text: “atoning sacrifice” is from the Greek “ιλασμος”, an appeasing, propitiating, or the means of appeasement or propitiation—the sacrifice that turns away God’s wrath because of our sin.

notes.after: he Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
notes.text: Or, “know what is true”, or, “know all things”

notes.after: o confesses the Son has the Father also.
notes.text: MT omits: He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

notes.after: d in us, that God has sent his only born
notes.text: The phrase “only born” is from the Greek word “μονογενη”, which is sometimes translated “only begotten” or “one and only”.

notes.after: nd sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice
notes.text: “atoning sacrifice” is from the Greek “ιλασμος”, an appeasing, propitiating, or the means of appeasement or propitiation—the sacrifice that turns away God’s wrath because of our sin.

notes.after: For there are three who testify:
notes.text: Only a few recent manuscripts add “in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one. And there are three that testify on earth:”
